subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Reva is / one of Gita’s best friend / in the class.
solution:
The erroneous part is option 1) i.e. **‘****one of Gita’s best friend’.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part ‘one of Gita’s best friend’.
 
• According to the rules of subject-verb agreement, if **'each, every, one' is used after 'of,' then the 'noun and pronoun' followed by 'of' will be in the plural number.**
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• *​One of my friends works in the defence ministry.*
 
 
 
• Therefore in the given sentence, we have to replace ‘one of Gita’s best friend’ with ‘one of Gita’s best friends’ to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct sentence:__ *Reva is **one of Gita’s best friends** in the class.*
